body:
Parent: #22 (Evidence & Data Trust).

## Traceability and dependencies
Requirements: FR-02, FR-03, FR-06 (defined in parent epic breakdown).
Depends on: #34, #35

## Outcome
A reviewer can inspect competing supplier/manufacturer observations and understand why a field value was selected or left unresolved.

## Scope and technical plan
- Introduce versioned, field-specific source precedence over observations; document source roles, freshness rules, normalization equivalence and deterministic ties in the shared plan.
- Keep all competing values and evidence IDs. Record selected observation, alternatives, policy/version and human-readable rationale; never silently discard disagreement.
- Separate manufacturer identity/specification authority from supplier offer authority for price/stock; do not infer verified manufacturer authority from a domain name alone.
- Define behavior for missing/unsupported/stale evidence, equal-priority conflicts and no supported candidates. Unresolved conflicts remain reviewable and never become asserted facts by arbitrary ordering.
- Integrate references with identity matching reports while preserving existing score semantics and matching compatibility.

## Acceptance scenarios
- Given disagreeing supplier and verified manufacturer specification values, when resolved under the documented policy, then selected value and both observations remain inspectable with the policy explanation.
- Given supplier offer and manufacturer list prices, then resolution uses the field's documented source authority rather than a universal rank.
- Given tied conflicting candidates or only unsupported candidates, then the state remains unresolved/unknown with reasons.
- Reordering identical input observations produces identical resolution; rule/model scores are not reported as validated confidence.

## Validation and task handoff
Table-driven authority/tie/freshness fixtures; conflict preservation and matching-report regressions. Update `research.md` with policy choices and `tasks.md` with requirement-linked checks.

## Spec Kit workflow
Use one shared feature directory, `specs/002-evidence-data-trust/`. Specify user outcomes and Given/When/Then scenarios in `spec.md`; record architecture, compatibility and resolved questions in `plan.md`; maintain dependency-ordered, requirement-linked work in `tasks.md`. Update the relevant artifacts before implementation and verify spec/plan/tasks consistency before closing this ticket. These are required implementation deliverables, not artifacts already generated by an installed Spec Kit workflow.

## Boundaries and definition of done
Evidence-backed reporting only; no catalog mutations, MCP, webhooks, or other epic work. Preserve MIT licensing and self-hostability. Prefer deterministic, offline fixtures; no model launch or broad live crawl is required. Document public APIs and limitations, and run meaningful affected compatibility checks. Do not equate extraction quality, rule/model scores, and validated confidence.

Implemented and pushed in PR #43: https://github.com/umerkhan95/shopextract/pull/43

Ready for review; this issue remains open until merge. Dependencies #34/#35 are merged and closed.

Acceptance coverage:
- Versioned field-specific authority: supplier offers versus explicitly verified manufacturer specifications; no authority inferred from hostnames.
- Every competing observation/evidence reference is retained with policy/version and selection/exclusion rationale.
- Equal-authority disagreement remains unresolved; typed equivalence and shuffled-input tests ensure deterministic selection without input-order or score-based authority.
- Explicit UTC evaluation time and configurable freshness exclude stale/future support without overwriting observations or scalar compatibility values.
- Matching reports include field-support references while existing relationship/confidence semantics remain unchanged.

Validation:
- 590 offline tests passed; focused resolver suite 55 passed.
- GitHub CI passed on Python 3.10, 3.11 and 3.12.
- 12 live cases passed across all six supported families and seven sites: 106 product observations, 262 variants and 5,282 field resolutions. Five actual API/HTML pairs retain alternatives; controlled fault probes are separately labeled synthetic.
- Two compact live-capture regressions cover Magento equivalent prices and Shopware supported API price versus unsupported HTML default.
- README, public documentation, spec/plan/research/tasks and both notebooks updated. Eight new offline cells executed successfully; all 63 notebook code cells syntax-checked and both notebooks validate as nbformat 4.5. Older network-dependent notebook sections were not rerun.
- git diff --check passed.

Review material: [public policy/API documentation](https://github.com/umerkhan95/shopextract/blob/resolve-field-sources/docs/field-resolution.md), [live review](https://github.com/umerkhan95/shopextract/blob/resolve-field-sources/artifacts/field-resolution-live/review.md), [offline example](https://github.com/umerkhan95/shopextract/blob/resolve-field-sources/examples/field_resolution.py).

Caller-established source roles and aligned product/variant/offer/currency context are explicit preconditions. Persistence (#37), portable Product bundles (#38) and full epic verification (#39) remain separate work.
